subject.title: fix(llm): summarize ephemeral tool results to preserve prefix cache

question: Should this PR ever summarize broad reasoning-tool outputs such as exec, read, web, and memory, or should it be narrowed to heartbeat/session-status style results before merge?
rationale: Tool-result visibility is a core agent behavior boundary: a cache win that hides command, file, web, or memory results can break normal follow-up reasoning, and code inspection alone should not bless that product policy.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Keep exec/read/web/memory-style outputs model-visible or recoverable and only summarize low-value heartbeat/session-status style results.

options.title: Pause for broader design
options.body: Stop this PR until maintainers define a general cache-safe tool-result projection policy for useful-but-large outputs.

options.title: Accept broad placeholders
options.body: Merge a broad placeholder policy only if maintainers intentionally accept that agents may lose direct visibility into those tool outputs.

recommendation.title: Narrow before merge
recommendation.body: Keep exec/read/web/memory-style outputs model-visible or recoverable and only summarize low-value heartbeat/session-status style results.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the strongest current-history signal on provider replay, tool-result truncation, and prompt/tool surfaces touched by this decision.
